newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Group to buy back 2.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Group to buy back 2.5 mln shares.

text.p: The Alpine Group said it will buy back up to 2.5 million shares -- or about 15 percent -- of the company's common stock outstanding.
The company did not say how long the buyback program would last.
Officials at the company were not immediately available.
The company also said that in connection with the program, it would further refinance its 12-1/4 percent senior notes with lower cost bank financing.
The company said the lower bank financing would affect earnings, although did not specify by how much.
As of December, the company had 17.4 million common shares outstanding.
